category_edits.rationale: Normalize nonpadding input embeddings to approximately sqrt(d) norm before the existing dropout to reduce input-scale variation and GRU gate saturation. Preserve padding zeros, candidate embeddings, scoring, topology, loss, and optimizer. All four dataset models use this change; the generated predictor imports the same updated model class, so no writer change is needed.
